title: Sonnet 5's Intro API Pricing Ends Aug 31 (+50% on Sept 1)
caption:
I built my cost model on a promo rate. Rookie mistake.

Sonnet 5's introductory API pricing ends Aug 31. From September 1 it's $3/$15 per million tokens instead of $2/$10, a flat 50% on every call my app makes. This is API billing, not the subscription plans.

So I turned on prompt caching this morning instead of complaining about it. Cache reads bill at 10% of input, which more than covers the difference.

Caching or eating it?

slides.title: Three levers
items: Prompt caching. Cache reads bill at 10% of input: $0.30 per million instead of $3.
Batch API. 50% off both directions, so Sonnet 5 runs $1.50 in, $7.50 out.
Haiku 4.5 stays $1 in, $5 out. Route the routine steps there.
